title: Shelby GT500 in the Night Studio on a Rainy Night
label: MIDNIGHT GARAGE
statement: Lock in. The world can wait.
description:
Step inside the Night Studio, where a satin black 1967 Shelby GT500 rests quietly under the low indoor glow. Just past the tall glass, rain streaks down into the dark, melting the city lights into soft, blurred colors. You are met with two hours of mellow, music-only lo-fi hip hop filled with jazzy keys and a gentle head-nod beat. It is a calm backdrop crafted for you to focus on work, study, or simply unwind and relax.

No talking. No lyrics. No sudden sounds. Every track is original, made for CEO Focus.

CEO Focus | Dream Cars. Easy Listening.
